welcome.headline:
Recover smarter,
not harder
welcome.body: A personalised rehab plan generated for your injury in seconds — backed by clinical evidence.
welcome.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.signInSub: Sign in to access your recovery plan.
auth.signUpSub: Save your plan and sync across devices.
auth.errPasswordShort: Password must be at least 6 characters

onboarding.step1Sub: We tailor your plan to your body and fitness level.
onboarding.step2Sub: Describe your injury or condition in your own words. The more detail, the better the plan.
onboarding.injuryPlaceholder: e.g. ACL surgery 2 weeks ago, sharp pain in left knee when bending past 90°…

tutorial.welcomeBody: Your AI-generated rehab plan is ready. Here's a quick tour — under 30 seconds.
tutorial.exercisesBody: Tap any exercise card on Home to see step-by-step instructions. Tap the circle to mark it done.
tutorial.hydrationBody: Tap a glass to log it. Aim for 8 a day — your tissues heal faster when hydrated.
tutorial.scheduleBody: Open the calendar tab to see all your sessions for the week and reorder them around your life.
tutorial.progressBody: The chart tab tracks pain, mobility and adherence so you can see your recovery curve.
tutorial.chatBody: Stuck on a movement or have a flare-up? The chat tab gives you 24/7 expert physio answers grounded in your plan.

home.restBody: Your body repairs during rest. Stay hydrated and sleep well tonight.
home.noPlanBody: Complete onboarding and we'll generate your AI clinical plan in seconds.
home.ctaPhysioLocked: AI Physio Chat — subscribe to unlock

hydration.title: Hydration
hydration.subtitle: 8 glasses · supports joint healing
hydration.tip0: Start your day with a glass of water

dayComplete.title: Day complete
dayComplete.body: Recovery happens between sessions. Hydrate, sleep well — your body's doing the rest of the work tonight.

streak.msg_3: Three sessions in a row. Your brain is starting to expect this — the habit is taking root.
streak.msg_7: Seven days of showing up. The hardest part of any habit is the start — you cleared it.
streak.msg_14: Recovery is compounding. Two weeks of consistent work is when real tissue change kicks in.
streak.msg_30: A full month. Your nervous system has rewired around movement. Keep going — this is how lasting recovery is built.
streak.msg_60: Two months of daily care for your body. This is athlete-tier discipline.
streak.msg_100: A hundred days. Whatever brought you here is far behind you now.

profile.notifsDisabledBody: Enable notifications for Mend AI in your system settings to use reminders.
profile.signOutBody: You'll have to sign back in to access your plan on this device.
profile.resetBody: This wipes your current plan, journal, hydration, and progress on this device. Your account stays — you just go through onboarding again.
profile.deleteBody: This permanently erases your plan, journal, chat history, and subscription. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteConfirmBody: Last chance — your account and all data will be erased forever.
profile.deleteFailedFallback: Could not delete account. Try again later.
